title: Sometime they are back in our dreams
content: Sometime they are back in our dreams By Alessandro Carosi I stayed over to sleep at my good friend I have past karmic relationships, we watched a beautiful TV series on Netflix called “Quenn’s gambit” we watched 3 episodes and I went to sleep. I had dream and woke up happy, serene but couldn’t remeber it and didn’t give it much importance, getting ready to go to work my friend advised me to go through Hyde park a much nicer route then through the main road and car traffic, I got my bycicle and arrived around the cafe’ I had to work for the day and then………like someone decided that was time for me to remember I clearly knew which was the dream, I was walking in Hyde Park in London when a girl with long hairs walked by me and notice from the corner of my eye that was someone I knew…..OMG!!!!! It was Kaori a beautiful Soul I had a short but powerful relationship here in the city and that had the same name of my first Love I met in Australia, we were both surprised to see each other, I knew she was back to Japan and never thought she would be back, it was a happy dream and I know it meant something powerful that’s why I was advised to ride my bycicle through Hyde park. The morning was filled with the number 77 that is now for me sign of being on the right path and last week the number 22 and 222 kept showing up all the time, I feel within that something beautiful is going to happen, not just for me but for the entire planet, we are evolving. …. https://anextraordinaryandordinarylifeblog.wordpress.com/2024/12/14/sometime-they-are-back-in-our-dreams-2/
